law_name: Law on Copyright and Related Rights (Decree No. 4-99-E of 1999, amended by Decree No. 16-2006)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 75 years (joint works: life of last surviving author + 75 years; anonymous/pseudonymous works counted from first lawful publication)
fair_use_exceptions: UNKNOWN (WIPO survey lists a specialized library exception covering preservation; no article numbers seen) (unconfirmed)
enforcement_body: Property Institute (Instituto de la Propiedad, IP) - General Directorate of Intellectual Property
notes: Berne in force 25 Jan 1990; WCT 20 May 2002; WPPT accession 2002 (older WIPO/IIPA sources); TRIPS inferred from signing of the WTO Final Act on 15 Apr 1995 (trade.gov) - no WTO list seen. Law promulgated 13 Dec 1999 (WIPO Lex) / in force 20 Jan 2000. Spanish text only; amendments after 2006 not checked.
